LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Setting_If_CheckMapBo: An aircraft that reaches the edge of the map turns back instead of being lost.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Setting_If_CanFireOnl: Landed aircraft do not shoot. While flying, melee attacks cannot reach them and explosions deal 20% damage.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Setting_If_AutoReload: Haulers bring ammo to landed aircraft and their weapon mounts whenever a magazine is not full. You can always order a reload by hand from the aircraft's gizmos, its tab or a right click.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Setting_If_ReloadAllW: Also reload weapons stored on board
Weapons kept in an aircraft besides the one in use are reloaded too, so the aircraft can switch to them when the current one runs dry.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Setting_If_ServiceOnl: Refuel and reload only inside the home area
The original mod only serviced aircraft inside the home area. Aircraft do not expand the home area, so an aircraft parked outside of it was never refuelled or reloaded. Off by default.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Setting_If_StunForces: EMP and stun force an aircraft to land

The original behaviour: any EMP or stun damage lands the aircraft, including the EMP that charged "ion" bullets of Combat Extended carry. Off: a stunned aircraft stays in the air and its weapons are silent while the stun lasts.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Departure_Cancel_Desc: Stay on this map: the aircraft is flying off the map edge towards another tile. The fuel for the trip is only used when it leaves.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_NothingToLandAt: There is nothing to land at on this tile.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_ReleaseAll_Desc: Let every pawn out of the aircraft, drafted.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_OutOfAmmo: {0}: {1} is out of ammo. Land it so colonists can reload it.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Service_NotInHomeArea: the aircraft is outside the home area (see the mod settings)
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_CannotReachOrReserved: cannot reach it, or someone else is using it
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_NoColonistCanReload: No colonist can reload it now.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Command_ReloadNow_Des: Send the closest free colonist to reload {0} with the selected ammo type.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_ReloadAll_Desc: Send colonists to reload every weapon of the aircraft that is not full (the aircraft must be landed).
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Weapon_Tip: Left click: choose a target for this weapon.\nRight click: more orders.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Weapon_NoneInRange: None of the chosen weapons reaches this target.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Weapon_SwitchTip: Switch to another weapon stored on board.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_AttackAll_Desc: Choose a target for every weapon of the aircraft: each one that reaches it shoots at it.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_StopAll_Desc: Every weapon of the aircraft forgets its ordered target and picks its targets again.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_HoldFireAll_Desc: No weapon of the aircraft shoots on its own. Ordering a weapon to attack a target lifts it for that weapon.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_ITab_LandToReload: Land the aircraft so colonists can reload and refuel it.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_LoadShell_Desc: Send the closest free colonist to load mortar shells into the bomb bay.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_BombRun_Desc:
Click a target: the aircraft flies over it and drops {0} bomb(s) along its approach.
Shift+click the start of a line, then click its end: the bombs fall evenly along the line.

Right click: bombs per run. With several bombers selected, each one makes the run.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_BombRun_MouseTarget: Click: bomb here. Shift+click: start of a line.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_BombRun_MouseLineEnd: Click the end of the line.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_BombRun_Cancel_Desc: Keep the remaining bombs; the aircraft flies on to the point it was heading for.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_BombRun_Status: Bombing run: {0} bomb(s) still to drop
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_BombRun_Busy: the aircraft is taking off or landing
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_BombRun_CannotReach: it could not get over the target
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Strafe_Desc:
Click a target: the aircraft flies along a short line through it and every weapon that reaches fires at a point walking along the line.
Shift+click the start of a line, then click its end, to strafe that line.

Weapons holding fire open fire for the run. With several aircraft selected, each one strafes a line beside the others.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Run_MapEdge: too close to the map edge, where aircraft turn back
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Strafe_Cancel_Desc: Stop the run: the weapons forget its points and pick their targets again.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_TroopDrop_Desc: Click where to drop them: the aircraft flies there, hovers and everyone on board but its crew ({0}) ropes down, drafted, one after another. Downed pawns stay aboard.\n\nOnly aircraft that take off vertically can hover. The tab also lets single pawns rope down while it hovers.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_TroopDrop_Mouse: Click where to drop the troops.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_TroopDrop_NotVtol: only aircraft that take off vertically can hover
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_TroopDrop_NotHovering: it must hover in place first
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_TroopDrop_NoTroops: nobody to drop: the crew ({0}) stays aboard and downed pawns cannot rope down
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_TroopDrop_NoRoom: {0}: no open ground below to rope down onto (roofs or walls).
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_TroopDrop_Downed: downed: land to let the pawn out
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Medevac_Desc:
Send the closest colonists to carry every downed colonist, slave, prisoner or guest within {0} cells aboard, as many as there are seats. Enemies are left.

On board the wounded do not bleed or worsen, as in a cryptosleep casket. At home, let them out: doctors take them to beds.

One by one: select a colonist and right click the aircraft.
LanguageData.AerocraftFramework_Medevac_Nobody: Nobody can carry the wounded aboard now.
